title: Branch `feature/order-export`
subtitle: Admins can export a month of orders as CSV from the Orders page.

sections.title: Goal
body: Finance copied orders out of the Orders grid by hand each month.
The project set out to export one month of orders as a CSV file that opens cleanly in Excel.

sections.title: How we achieved it
body: - **Streamed on the server.** `ExportOrdersAsync` writes rows as it reads them, so a large month doesn't sit in memory.
- **Same filters as the grid.** The export takes the grid's current filter, so what you see is what you get.

sections.title: Changes that reach other features
sections.body: None. Every change is inside the Orders feature.

sections.title: Deployment notes
sections.body: No database change. Set `Export:MaxRows` in app settings (default 50000).

sections.title: Risks and follow-ups
body: - Months over 50,000 orders are cut off; follow-up to page the export.

groups.title: Server

why.src/Orders/OrderExportService.cs: Streams a month of orders as CSV, using the grid's filter so the file matches the screen.
why.src/Orders/OrdersController.cs: Adds GET /orders/export for admins and passes the grid filter through.
why.web/orders/export-button.tsx: The Export button, disabled while a download is running so it can't be clicked twice.
